_comment: sim-setdown-shelf-contact-v1. Purpose: stop the collect place-on-cart SET-DOWN from riding the rollwagen shelf's +x (mouth) edge and pivoting the carton +2.06 deg off level (coldwin33/34/35: CARTON_TILT at phase=place, the IDENTICAL +2.06 deg each run, a CONTACT pivot -- three generations of droop compensation PR 311/318/326 left the executed value unchanged, d(executed)/d(commanded) ~ 0). CPU reconstruction (data/sim-setdown-shelf-contact-v1): the shipped place descent interpolates the TCP on a SINGLE diagonal straight line from the pre-place standoff (the fixed collect_place_preplace_shape parks the held carton OUT IN FRONT of the cart, overhanging the open +x mouth) down+in to the support load-centre. That diagonal drags the carton ACROSS the /Rollwagen/chassis/shelf front-top (mouth) edge while the carton bottom is already below the shelf top -- at the shelf-top crossing the carton's front edge is +51 mm PAST the mouth edge -- so the carton lands on the edge and pivots (height 0.706 m above the deck, hit_bodies=['/Rollwagen/chassis/shelf'], SEAL_DIAG face-normal flips to the front-top edge (-0.11,-0.69,0.71)). The fix routes the set-down as an L-path through the CLEAR opening above the support: horizontal at the standoff height (clear of the shelf top) to DIRECTLY ABOVE the load-centre, then VERTICAL down -- so the carton reaches the shelf top with its whole footprint INSIDE the shelf (front edge -46 mm, i.e. 46 mm inside the mouth edge) and lands FLAT/level. The per-waypoint reach+level+droop-cancel IK and the CARTON_TILT bound (2.0 deg) and grace (0.15 s) are UNCHANGED; no collider is removed and the carton is not shrunk.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config (scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json in THIS repo -- restock_host/launch.py ships the repo file to the host; it is NOT the dataset host.json). Replace the bare `"carton_level": true` with this mapping. resolve_level_config fills every other carton_level field from its defaults, so this is byte-identical to `true` except for the three place_* keys below.
_place_from_above_note: Default FALSE => the legacy single diagonal straight-line descent => byte-identical. TRUE routes the collect-deck level place descent (controller._collect_deck_place + level_place) as the horizontal-then-vertical L-path so the carton descends onto the support from directly above and lands flat. Scoped to the collect place descent only; every other carried move (lift/tuck/transit/preplace/retreat) is unchanged.
_place_above_clearance_m_note: Metres. Minimum carton-above-support height of the horizontal-leg via-point (the standoff is already ~63 mm above the shelf top, so 0.08 keeps the horizontal leg clear of the shelf top with margin). Only used when place_from_above is on.
_place_depth_bias_m_note: Metres. OPTIONAL extra margin: nudges the set-down DEEPER into the cart (along the horizontal approach direction, away from the mouth) so the overhanging side-grip suction panel lands further from the mouth edge. 0.0 already lands the carton 46 mm inside the mouth edge (flat). The carton has room to go deeper (shelf back at cart-x -0.38, carton back at -0.003); 0.05 gives ~94 mm inside-edge clearance. Leave 0.0 unless the bounded GPU run shows the suction panel (which hangs ~37 mm below the carton bottom) still clipping the mouth edge -- in that case prefer shifting the EXTERNAL load-centre (below) over a large bias.
_alternative_external_load_centre: The place load-centre and support height come from the EXTERNAL mission-runtime config (manipulation.cart_placement.load_center_body_xy / support_z_world) and the external mission-scenario initial_staging (cart_load_center_body_xy / cart_support_z_world, used by the ground-truth collect warm-slot). They are NOT in this repo. The failing run placed at cart-rel (0.18, 0) on the UPPER SHELF top (support_z_world=0.9325). If more mouth-edge margin for the suction panel is wanted without a code depth bias, shift that external load_center_body_xy deeper (more -x, toward the cart interior), e.g. (0.13, 0); the carton stays well within the shelf footprint. Coordinate the external-config change with the integration lane.
_requires: Register nothing new: the three keys are nested under the already-registered HOST key `carton_level` (config_preflight knows `carton_level`). Keep the run's existing RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH / cart_placement.support_z_world (shelf) as-is.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Cold collect-only (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, --stop-after collect) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with the repo ros_host_config.json carried the carton_level mapping above. Expected PASS at the set-down segment: the CARTON_LEVEL_PLACE_DESCENT log prints `approach=from_above`; the carton descends vertically onto the shelf top; CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place stays well under the 2.0 deg bound; at the set-down tick hit_bodies is the support (deck/shelf top face) only, NOT the shelf +x edge; the gripper releases and the carton rests level on the support; NO CARTON_TILT trip. If the suction panel still clips the mouth edge, add place_depth_bias_m:0.05 (or shift the external load-centre deeper) and re-run.
